title: `ls 'one`<newline>`two/etc/pa`: zsh offers nothing, zshrs runs the whole completer chain down to corrections

observed.detail: diverges at step #1 ('tab'); first diff row 2 col 0; 19 row(s) differ
observed.notes: Both shells answer the Enter with PS2 — the buffer is deliberately incomplete at the newline, so nothing executes and the completion fires inside the continuation. The single-line control below completes the same word with the newline removed and PASSES, which is what makes the CONTINUATION the variable rather than the word. Under the checked-in zstyle fixture (whose `completer` style is `_expand _ignored _megacomplete _approximate _correct ...`) zshrs walks the chain and paints `-<<corrections (errors: 2)>>-`, `-<<original>>-` and a directory listing over ten rows of repeated `_describe:compdescribe` errors; zsh draws nothing at all. Row 16 onward carry the corrections block, so the whole listing is one-sided.

controls.note: `ls 'one two/etc/pa` on one line under the same zstyle fixture: PASSES.

confirmed.note: round 6 re-confirmation, from the full gate run in tests/compsys_fixtures/last_gate.json. What that run established: verdict STILL-DIVERGES; the harness's own detail was '24 row(s) differ from step #1 (tab), first row 0 col 0'; this harness computes no fingerprint, so what was re-verified is the verdict and that detail line, not row-for-row identity with `observed`. SHAPE MOVED: `observed` records 19 differing row(s), this run reported 24. The cell still diverges and the fixture stands, but the rows recorded under `observed` are from the earlier run and no longer match it line for line
